description: This file defines application dependencies and bootstrap logic for initializing core services such as cache, database, content repository, and download engine in a Flutter/Dart project.

classes.name: AppDependencies
classes.description: A container class holding core service instances such as cache, repository, database, and download engine.

classes.name: AppBootstrap
classes.description: A utility class responsible for bootstrapping and initializing core application services asynchronously.

methods.name: bootstrap
methods.description: Asynchronously initializes shared preferences, cache, database, content repository with cache and fake backend, and download engine, returning an instance of AppDependencies.
